verdict.rationale: The Sessions API lets you create and drive Droid sessions, including managing their messages (factory-docs-13). The Factory App lets you give in-session feedback through design mode and inline diff comments that Droid "acts on in place" (factory-docs-31), and the interactive CLI provides an ongoing session rather than one-shot runs (factory-docs-15, factory-docs-30). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of interrupting or redirecting an agent mid-run without restarting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of steering behavior.
